project.name: 考试学习平台
project.styleDefinitionBrief: 清新活力学习App，翠绿主色+明亮卡片+圆润元素，激励学习节奏，类似多邻国的活泼感但更克制
project.designRead: mobile study app / students & exam takers / fresh energetic motivating / medium density / avoid cold corporate feel

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: emerald green #10B981 used for primary CTA, selected states, and progress indicators
colorSystem.brandHuePolicy: single emerald hue; categories use neutral tints or state colors (success/warning/error/info) for semantic meaning only

styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: rounded cards 12px radius, buttons 8px, large elements 16px, pills 9999px
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Noto Sans SC for all text, 800 weight for headings, 400-700 for body, tight letter-spacing on display
styleContinuityAnchors.spacingSystem: 4px base, 8/12/16/20/24/32px scale, generous padding inside cards
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: card-based layout with soft shadows, rounded corners, colorful icon backgrounds, bottom navigation with 5 tabs
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: white surfaces on light gray bg, border-first depth with subtle shadow (alpha ≤ 0.05), elevated surfaces only for modals/floating layers
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: Lucide-style line icons with colored circular backgrounds, no photographs, CSS patterns for visual interest
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: energetic but refined, smooth transitions, spring easing on interactive elements

sharedProjectShellContract.navigationShell: fixed bottom nav with 5 tabs (首页/题库/练习/导入/我的), 导入 tab has emphasis style, active tab uses primary color
sharedProjectShellContract.primaryColorSystem: emerald green #10B981 primary, #059669 strong, #ECFDF5 soft, no secondary/accent brand hue
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: Noto Sans SC, 800 weight headings, 400 body, 11-28px scale
sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: border-first, shadow alpha ≤ 0.05 for static, elevated shadow for modals only
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: primary CTA: solid emerald bg, white text, 12px radius, 44px min-height; secondary: surface bg with border
sharedProjectShellContract.alignmentRules: left-aligned content, 16px page padding, 12px card gaps, consistent 44px touch targets

designSource.designDecisionSummary: Emerald green primary, clean white surfaces, rounded 12px cards, Noto Sans SC typography, energetic but restrained, card-based mobile layout with bottom navigation

pages.title: 首页
pages.businessScenario: App entry point with greeting, quick action grid, study stats overview, and recent courses list
pages.visualNorthStar: Energetic green-accented home screen that immediately shows learning progress and provides clear action entry points, like a fitness app dashboard for studying
pages.compositionPattern: Stacked card rhythm: gradient header greeting → 2x2 quick action grid → stats row → recent course cards
qualityRisks: dense first screen with many elements
balancing data display with visual energy

pages.title: 题库列表
pages.businessScenario: Browse and manage question banks with search, filter, and course cards showing question count and last practiced date
pages.visualNorthStar: Clean scrollable list of course cards with clear hierarchy, each card inviting a tap to start practicing
pages.compositionPattern: Search bar → filter chips → vertical card list with icon, title, metadata, and practice CTA

pages.title: 练习中心
pages.businessScenario: Choose practice mode (course practice, wrong-question review, due review, history) with overview stats and recent courses
pages.visualNorthStar: Motivating practice launcher with clear mode cards, each with distinct colored icon, showing today's progress and entry points
pages.compositionPattern: Stats overview card → 2x2 mode card grid → recent course list with quick-start buttons
qualityRisks: mode card differentiation without multiple brand hues

pages.title: 题库练习
pages.businessScenario: Immersive question practice screen with progress bar, question stem, answer options, and action bar (submit, skip, flag)
pages.visualNorthStar: Focused full-screen practice experience with clear question hierarchy, tappable answer options with immediate visual feedback, progress visible at top
pages.compositionPattern: Immersive topbar (progress + counter + back) → question card (stem + type tag) → answer options → sticky action bar

pages.title: AI 导入
pages.businessScenario: Upload files (Word/PPT/PDF) or paste JSON to import questions via AI parsing, with format preview and import progress
pages.visualNorthStar: Clean upload interface with drag-drop zone, format capability strip, and AI-powered parsing preview that feels smart and reliable
pages.compositionPattern: Upload zone (large dashed card) → capability strip (supported formats) → paste-JSON toggle → preview list → import CTA

pages.title: 考试答题
pages.businessScenario: Immersive exam screen with countdown timer, question navigation panel, question stem, answer options, and submit button
pages.visualNorthStar: Focused exam experience with prominent timer, clear question navigation, and confidence-inspiring answer interface
pages.compositionPattern: Immersive topbar (timer + counter + back) → question card (stem + type) → answer options → question navigator grid → sticky submit bar

pages.title: 我的
pages.businessScenario: User profile with avatar, study stats summary, menu entries (wrong book, bookmarks, history, settings, admin)
pages.visualNorthStar: Personal dashboard with avatar header, study achievement stats, and clear menu navigation that feels rewarding
pages.compositionPattern: Profile header (avatar + name + stats) → achievement stat row → menu list with icons → admin entry if applicable
